parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: ID of your own user. `me` is also accepted for the signed-in user

otpauth_url.description: OTP Auth URL for QR Code generation

200.description: The pending TOTP secret and its otpauth address

403.description: Not allowed: API tokens are refused here, use a signed-in session. The answer is an error with the message `API tokens cannot manage users`.

description:
Creates a new TOTP secret for your own account and returns it with an `otpauth_url` for a QR code. TOTP is not on until you confirm a code from your authenticator with the enable route within 10 minutes; a new start replaces the unconfirmed secret. Only for your own account, and 400 when TOTP is already on.

Needs: a signed-in session as that user (API tokens are refused)
